name: Trade Counterparty Relationship Record 1
definition: Specifies the relationship record between two parties.

StartRelationshipParty.name: Start Relationship Party
StartRelationshipParty.definition: Specifies type of counterparty at the start of a directional relationship.

EndRelationshipParty.name: End Relationship Party
EndRelationshipParty.definition: Specifies type of counterparty at the end of a directional relationship.

RelationshipType.name: Relationship Type
RelationshipType.definition: Type of relationship between two parties.||Usage: RelationshipType is always in the direction of the StartRelationshipParty to EndRelationshipParty.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Provides description of other type of relationship between two parties.||Usage: Description is to be used only when RelationshipType is not precisely indicating the type of relationship between parties to the transaction.
